retratacoes.acusado: parte01 nomeia #47 Eternal Flame, #48 Eternal Guard, #49 Eternal Pool, #50 Exploding Skeleton e #51 Extinguished Altar. Nenhum desses títulos existe nos 256 registros do JSON, e a chave resources.assets:2545597 não é citada em lugar nenhum do documento.

O único GUID duplicado real dos 256 registros é 5b740c2b-3480-48f2-997b-88c8291db0c0 em resources.assets:2545539 e :2545540 (#9 Battle e #10 Battletest Event), fora da faixa 41–60.
retratacoes.efeito: RETRATADO INTEGRALMENTE: a recomendação de corrigir os ids 46–51 fica retirada; não há defeito a corrigir nesses seis eventos. A duplicação real (#9/#10) é registrada como sinalização fora do escopo desta faixa, para cartão próprio.

retratacoes.real: Vazios narrativos reais da faixa: #43 Enchanted Symbol com $.texto = '\n' (1 caractere, U+000A), #47 Etched Rune com $.texto = '\n' (1 caractere) e #56 Hard Battle com $.texto = '' (0 caracteres). retratacoes.real: #54 Gold Statue of the First Mountain King e #58 Hell Coffer têm raridade {valor:4,nome:Mythic} VERDADEIRA, categoria=Normal, peso=1.0 e pool=[{valor:0,nome:Normal}]. retratacoes.efeito: RETRATADO INTEGRALMENTE: retiradas a acusação de inconsistência e qualquer proposta de downgrade ou de movimentação de lote. Raridade e pool são campos independentes e ambos estão coerentes na fonte.

eventos.texto:
Rising from the earth like the tooth of some gargantuan beast, an obelisk crafted entirely from limestone, ancient and weathered stands proud and defiant. 

Upon the weather-beaten stone, a single white rune is etched, glowing softly in the dying light of the day. Its luminescence pulsing gently, in rhythm with the heart of the world. Even from a distance, you can sense its potent magic, a beacon drawing you towards it.

opcoes.texto: Press the palm of your hand upon the obelisk.
Draw the energy from the limestone obelisk.

eventos.justificativa: MANTER. As duas opções são distintas em efeito E em narrativa: «Activate the blessing» grava o status Brilliance (opcoes[1].efeitos[1].efeitos[1].recompensas.status.candidatos[1] = resources.assets:2545415, «@Intelligence@ increased by {4,20}», duração Quest) e «Heal from the obelisk» grava vida_mana {percentMaxHealth:50.0, percentMaxMana:50.0} em Self. Os activationText de sucesso também diferem entre as opções («a pulse of energy courses through» contra «The magic flows into»). Não há cura zero, não há texto idêntico entre as opções e não há defeito de configuração demonstrado. Sem alteração proposta.

eventos.texto: You stumble upon an unlikely sight: an Enchanted Pumpkin Patch, nestled amidst the wilderness. Vibrant pumpkins of all sizes dot the landscape, their rich orange hue glow like embers in the creeping shadows. At the heart of the patch, keeping a silent vigil, stands a towering scarecrow. Its form is grotesquely exaggerated, angular and ominous under the light, its eyes twin points of baleful luminescence in its shadowed face. Despite its ghastly appearance, a strange, palpable magic thrums in the air around it, tying it to the very life force of the pumpkin patch.

opcoes.texto: Reach down and take a Pumpkin.
As enticing as it seems, some treasures are not meant to be taken.

Texto e configuração estão alinhados. Sem alteração proposta.

eventos.texto: A Wild Boar, powerfully built and grim-eyed, is caught in a thorny snare. The thick Bristlethorn, is tough as twisted iron and studded with wicked thorns that dig deep into the boar's hide. Every movement the boar makes only seems to make the situation worse. The thorns bite deeper into its flesh, drawing forth beads of crimson that seep into the rich, damp earth. It thrashes and grunts in raw, unfiltered fear and pain, its eyes wild with the primitive instinct of a creature trapped and in distress.

opcoes.texto: Attempt to free the boar.
The potential risks are too great.

eventos.texto: Suddenly, the ground beneath your feet quakes, and a deafening rumble echoes through the air. The peaceful serenity is shattered as a Volcanic Fissure explodes out of the earth, spewing forth a tide of molten rock and clouds of choking ash. As you look up, you see a shower of ash and embers falling towards you, a rain of fire and death. It will take only a moment for the molten rock to reach you, for the ash to smother your vision, your breath.

opcoes.texto: Flee the cataclysmic eruption.

A monolith stands like a sentinel, its massive form casting a long shadow over the sun-baked ground. Crafted from stone, weathered by time, it holds an imposing grandeur that dwarfs you.

It is unadorned, save for a singular, mysterious red rune that pulses at its heart, a vibrant contrast against the stone's gray expanse. It radiates an energy that thrums in your veins, a tangible vibration that resonates with your very being.

opcoes.texto: Press the palm of your hand upon the monolith.

eventos.texto:
Even amidst the fantastical nature of your journey, this particular fungus stands as a peculiar sight that draws you closer.

With a cautious curiosity, you move in for a closer look. It is a beautiful, delicate structure, its colors undulating in the ethereal light it emits. As you approach, the fungus seems to react, pulsating in a faster rhythm. Before you can pull back, it releases a sudden cloud of gas, the spores transforming from beautiful light to a dangerous, toxic fog.

Choking and gasping, you stagger back, but not before inhaling a dose of the poisonous spores.

opcoes.texto: Do your best to weather the poison.

eventos.justificativa: MANTER. Opção única «Resist»: Success em limite 10 (XP 0.5 a Party) e Failure em limite 0 (-30 percentMaxHealth em Self junto do status «Enfeebled»). O texto original já descreve a nuvem de esporos tóxicos, coerente com a rolagem de resistência. Sem alteração proposta.
eventos.retratacao: A seção 48 de parte01 (título inventado «Eternal Guard», GUID duplicado falso) é substituída integralmente por este evento real.

eventos.texto: This cave, previously draped in a sullen darkness, comes alive in a feverish light. The source of this illumination is a Giant Ruby, its radiant glow throwing a surreal dance of shadows on the stone walls. This gem is unlike any you had seen before, a pulsating heart in the belly of the earth, casting an allure that is both mesmerizing and disconcerting. It lays nestled atop a rock pedestal, its facets catching the light and fracturing it into a thousand crimson shards. You find yourself drawn to it, enraptured by its brilliance, your gaze reflected in its fiery depths. As you venture closer, your steps echo in the cavernous silence, you notice you are not alone. Other shadows move around you, dancing in the ruby's glow, creeping closer. Other adventurers, driven by the same allure, the same pursuit.

opcoes.texto: Grab the ruby before someone else does.
Pull yourself away from the allure of the ruby.

eventos.texto: Your path is obstructed by an elaborate trap - a deadly Furnace of ancient design, capable of reducing even the sturdiest of adventurers to ash. From the numerous vents scattered across the floor, a sudden gush of heat erupts. Flames leap out with a voracious hunger, casting monstrous shadows that dance with a ferocious intensity. The path ahead is transformed into a river of fire, a fatal obstacle promising a fiery demise.

opcoes.texto: Brave the flames to disable the trap.

eventos.titulo: Gold Statue of the First Mountain King
eventos.nome_asset: Gold Statue of the First Mountain King
eventos.texto:
A statue, towering and grand, gleams with a lustre untouched by time. The magnificent statue, cast from pure gold, is a testament to the great skill and artistry of the dwarves. It is a glorious depiction of the <gold>First Mountain King</gold>, a legendary figure who laid the foundation for the dwarven kingdom.


You stand in awe, your gaze drawn to the intricately detailed armor, the steadfast expression, and the hefty hammers held firmly in the king's grip. The temptation of the golden figure is potent - it is a treasure that could secure fortunes, a prize that could change your life.

opcoes.texto: Give into temptation and take what you can.
You can't bring yourself to destroy this monument, the essence of a rich and proud dwarven culture.

To pass through unscathed would require not only agility but also impeccable timing.

eventos.texto: You stand around a Hulking Safe, its matte black exterior reflecting the dim torchlight. The solid steel structure is an intimidating sight, its austere facade is marked only by a complex locking mechanism, a series of concentric rings each adorned with cryptic symbols and numbers. No visible latch, no obvious keyhole. Just this unyielding enigma waiting to be solved. An opportunity for immense wealth, shrouded in an armor of cold, hardened steel.

opcoes.texto: Try and crack the safe.
You simply do not have the time to linger here for hours attempting to crack the safe.

eventos.texto: Suspended above a stone pedestal is a Hell Coffer, an object of legend and fear. Encrusted with jagged obsidian and adorned with runes glowing as though forged in hellfire, the coffer is an infernal masterpiece. The stories whisper of such artifacts, constructs of the demonic realms where damned lords store their most precious possessions. The promise of the treasure it holds is an intoxicating allure to any mortal. Yet, it is a lure designed to ensnare the greedy and unwary, drawing them into a pact with powers they could hardly fathom.

opcoes.texto: Attempt to loot the Hell Coffer.
Think better of falling for this devlish trap.

eventos.texto: In a conflagration of heat and ash, a Hell Gate erupts into existence before you. Its molten edges twist and writhe, the stench of sulfur and brimstone filling the air. It casts a wicked light onto your face, painting the scene in hues of orange and red, flickering like the heart of a fire. Your heart pounds in your chest, adrenaline surging through your veins as you weigh your options. Flee and live, or stay and face whatever horror is to step from the fiery gateway.

opcoes.texto: See what exits the portal to satisfy your curiosity.
No amount of curiosity can convince you wait around to see what exits this Infernal Portal.

eventos.texto:
A magical reef, completely out of place on dry land, captures your attention instantly. It is as if a slice of the ocean was suddenly transported and dropped right here in front of you, held in place by an invisible tube of water.

Glowing fish swim around, their luminescent forms painting streaks of color against the murky backdrop. A plethora of coral structures jut out, splashing life onto this land-locked aquatic oasis. Your hand moves forward, pressing against the surface of the cone. The invisible barrier gives way, cool water enveloping your skin as your hand plunges into the underwater wonderland.

Then you spot it – whispers of treasure, glistening from within the underwater biome. The metallic gleam catching the ambient light from the glowing fish and turning it into a beacon calling you.

opcoes.texto: Swim towards the treasure.
